localizedValues.name: NCOS
localizedValues.description:
This is not a pet friendly accommodation. No pets are allowed in the vacation houses or on the covered porch areas even in crates or kennels.
The NCO Quarters South is one half of a duplex that accommodates up to four people in each unit. It was built above the shoreline in 1903 and overlooks the water. Each unit includes two bedrooms (one room with a queen and the other with two twins) and one bathroom with a clawfoot tub upstairs. Downstairs, there is a comfortable kitchen with modern appliances and a cozy living room with a TV & DVD player. Pots, pans, plates and utensils are provided. Renters must provide their own linens (any blankets, sheets, pillows, and towels). Smoking is not allowed in vacation houses.
NOTE: CUT OFF DATE FOR MAKING RESERVATIONS AT THE VACATION HOUSES IS THREE DAYS PRIOR TO ARRIVAL DATE.

Each unit includes two bedrooms (one room with a queen and the other with two twins) and one bathroom with a clawfoot tub upstairs. Downstairs, there is a comfortable kitchen with modern appliances and a cozy living room with a TV & DVD player. Pots, pans, plates and utensils are provided. localizedValues.name: ENG
localizedValues.description:
The Engineers House is a century-old 800 square foot house overlooking Admiralty Inlet and Whidbey Island with views of Mt Baker and Mt Rainier.
This is not a pet friendly accommodation. No pets are allowed in the vacation houses or on the covered porch areas even in crates or kennels.
There is a fenced yard, picnic table and deck with chairs and small table. The house includes two sleeping rooms (one room with a queen and the other with a twin bunked bed) and one bathroom with shower. There is a kitchen with small breakfast table, modern appliances and a living room. Pots, pans, plates and utensils are provided. A TV & DVD player are located in the master bedroom. Renters must provide their own linens (any blankets, sheets, pillows, and towels). Smoking is not allowed in vacation houses.
NOTE: CUT OFF DATE FOR MAKING RESERVATIONS AT THE VACATION HOUSES IS THREE DAYS PRIOR TO ARRIVAL DATE.

The Waterway House features four bedrooms with two queen and four single beds, two baths with showers, a modern kitchen, and a living room with a TV & DVD Player. Pots, pans, plates, and utensils are provided. Renters must provide their own linens (any blankets, sheets, pillows, and towels). Smoking is not allowed in vacation houses.

localizedValues.name: G1 - Wagon Wheel
localizedValues.description:
The Wagon Wheel group camp has a covered shelter, 2 vault toilets, in a wooded area. 40 tents (number of tents is determined by size of tent and number of RVs) or 30 RVs. Fees vary with size of the group.
There is a minimum billable party size of 50 for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.

localizedValues.name: G2 - Scout Camp
localizedValues.description:
Scout group camp with 1 vault toilet and no showers. The scout area accommodates tents only with a maximum of 40 people. Tent size determines number tents. There is a fire ring and one open-sided shelter and 4 picnic tables.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.

localizedValues.name: Recreation Hall
localizedValues.description:
Groups MUST contact the park in advance at (360) 344-4412 for a Special Activity Permit for weddings over 20 people and special equipment (i.e. canopies, dunk tanks, inflatable bouncer toys, climbing walls, or similar items).
This day use heritage place provides an excellent facility for meetings, classroom activities, and special events. The facility is located at historic Fort Flagler once occupied by soldiers of the Coast Artillery regiments protecting Admiralty Inlet.
Rental is heated with electric/propane heat and includes a restroom, projection screen, and a small kitchen complete with cook top stove, oven, microwave, refrigerator, and freezer. Outdoor there are picnic tables and an 3 by 3 foot charcoal grill. The use of 15 folding tables and 75 chairs come with the rental (Indoor use only).
Interior capacity of 75 people. Combined with grounds rental, capacity of 100.

localizedValues.name: S1-Picnic Shelter
localizedValues.description:
Groups MUST contact the park in advance at (360) 344-4412 for a Special Activity Permit for weddings over 20 people and special equipment (i.e. canopies, dunk tanks, inflatable bouncer toys, climbing walls, or similar items).
This picnic shelter is covered, no electricity on the west side of the island across the road from the Kilisut Harbor launch and the concession area. The shelter has 5 picnic tables and large fire ring. Restroom facilities and water tap nearby.
There is a minimum billable party size of 50 people for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.

localizedValues.name: Theater
localizedValues.description:
PLEASE NOTE: If your group is 20 or more and conducting organized activities such as a wedding or community event, you MUST contact the park in advance at 360-385-1259 or fort.flagler@parks.wa.gov for a Special Activity Permit at least 60 days in advance of your event.
This day-use historic theater provides an excellent facility for special events, meetings, plays, and other auditorium events. The facility is located at historic Fort Flagler once occupied by soldiers of the Coast Artillery regiments protecting Admiralty Inlet.
Rental is heated with electric/propane heat and includes a large auditorium with a stage, two ADA restrooms, and a small utility room with a sink and refrigerator. We provide up to 250 folding chairs and 10 round 6’ banquet tables for indoor use only. The facility must be left in a tidy condition with chairs and tables stacked and returned to their storage locations. A sound system, AV screen, stage lights and microphones are available with additional audio-visual equipment use fee.
A 2,500 square foot auditorium floor space. Interior capacity of 275 people.
